Oct 16, 2026Spirula Studio trains 3D Gaussian Splatting models - from raw photo/video to splat to textured mesh - in one self-contained binary. No Python/PyTorch, no separate COLMAP install. Runs on NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple GPUs via Vulkan, trains 10M full-SH Gaussians in 8 GB VRAM, and has native support for fisheye and 360° cameras.
